<meta>continues from previous page: adversaries;</meta> and it gives prophecy, and the interpretation of all dreams: and makes one understand enigmas.

¶ If you wish to have a good understanding in the senses, and to be unable to become drunk: take the stone which is called **Amethyst** <note>original: "Amatistus"</note>; and it is of a purple color, and the best is born in India and is powerful against drunkenness. And it bestows a good understanding of knowable things <note>referring to academic or scientific knowledge</note>.

<margin>+</margin>
¶ If you wish to conquer enemies and flee from lawsuits: take the stone which is called **Beryl** <note>original: "Berillus"</note>; and it is of a pale color with light transparent as water <note>original: "limphe"</note>. Carry it with you and you will conquer all lawsuits and put enemies to flight; and it will make an enemy mild. In matters of conduct, it grants effective power, just as Aaron says <note>likely referring to a pseudo-epigraphical work on gems attributed to the biblical Aaron</note>. It also gives a good understanding of knowable things.

¶ If you wish to divine concerning future things: take the stone which is called **Chelonite** <note>original: "Chelonytes," a stone traditionally believed to be found in the head of a tortoise</note>; and it is of a varied purple color, and is <margin>-</margin> found in the body of a tortoise. If anyone, however, carries this stone under their tongue, they will divine and predict future things. Nevertheless, it has no power unless the first light has been kindled, and during the waxing moon until the last descent <note>This indicates that the stone's divinatory power is dependent on the phases of the moon</note>. Thus Aaron dictates concerning the virtues of stones and herbs.

<margin>+</margin>
If you wish to calm storms and cross rivers: take the stone which is called **Coral** <note>original: "Corallus"</note> and it is red, while another kind is white. And it has been tested that it immediately restricts blood and, when carried, drives away foolishness and grants wisdom; and this has been tested by some in our own time; and it is powerful against storms and the dangers of rivers.

<summary>This page describes the virtues of Amethyst, Beryl, Chelonite, and Coral, detailing their powers to prevent drunkenness, win legal disputes, predict the future, and provide protection during travel.</summary>
